bots.name: Pawnsworth
bots.blurb: A friendly beginner. Leaves pieces lying around and loves a free pawn.

bots.name: Sir Scatter
bots.blurb: Leaves pieces loose all over the board. Punish him with forks and f7.

bots.name: Baron Dawdle
bots.blurb: Never castles in time. Keep his king in the middle.

bots.name: Duchess Thin
bots.blurb: Defends her king with as few pieces as possible. Bring everyone.

bots.name: Captain Pusher
bots.blurb: Pushes the pawns in front of his own king. Rip the roof.

bots.name: Lady Lockstep
bots.blurb: Never makes a hole for her king. Back-rank tricks work.

bots.name: Colonel Column
bots.blurb: Lines his king and queen up. Pins and skewers.

bots.name: Madame Mask
bots.blurb: Ignores what is hiding behind your pieces. Discovered attacks.

bots.name: Earl Boxed
bots.blurb: Huddles his pieces around his king until it cannot breathe.

bots.name: One-Guard Gwen
bots.blurb: Trusts a single defender. Deflect it.

bots.name: Professor Assume
bots.blurb: Assumes you will always recapture. Zwischenzug.

bots.name: Marathon Mo
bots.blurb: Trades everything and runs for the endgame. Finish him.
